Looking at this qlang documentation, I need to understand the pipeline language fundamentals before writing queries. Let me work through each task systematically.

Key insights:
- `|` pipes values between steps
- `*` applies a step to each element
- `~(...)` creates quoted code
- `/key` reads from maps/arrays; `at :key` reads softly (returns null if missing)
- `filter`, `groupBy`, `sort` are container verbs
- `coalesce` provides defaults for null values

Here are my queries, written on first attempt:

O1: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") | * (at :total | coalesce 0) | sum

O2: filter ~(/status | lower | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(/region) | * count

O3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/labels | any ~(lower | eq "bug")) | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * /number

O4: filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | * (/assignee/login | lower) | distinct | sort

O5: /dependencies | union (/devDependencies) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * /0 | sort

O6: filter ~(at :address | ne null) | filter ~(/address | at :city | ne null) | filter ~(/address | at :city | lower | eq "berlin") | * {:id /id :name /name :email (at :email)}

O7: /services | filter ~((at :enabled | coalesce true) | eq true) | filter ~(has :port) | * [(/name | keyword) /port] | tag ::map

O8: /data/items | filter ~(/type | eq "click") | * (at :duration_ms) | filter ~(ne null) | :durs / | (:durs | sum) | div (:durs | count) | round 2

O9: lines | * (split " " | /2) | groupBy | * count | entries | sort ~([(/1 | desc) /0]) | take 2 | * {:path (/0 | keyword) :count /1}

O10: lines | drop 1 | * (split "," | {:dept /1 :salary (/2 | if (ne "") ~(parseJson) ~(null))}) | filter ~(/salary | ne null) | groupBy ~(/dept) | * (* /salary | :sals / | (:sals | sum) | div (:sals | count) | round 1)

O11: lines | filter ~((startsWith "#") | not) | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(contains "==") | * (split "==" | /0) | * lower | sort | join ","

O12: split ", " | * (split ":" | {:name (/0 | lower) :value (/1 | parseJson)}) | groupBy ~(/name) | * (* /value | sum)

O13: * /items | flat | groupBy ~(/sku) | * (* /qty | sum) | entries | sort ~([(/1 | desc) /0]) | take 3 | * {:sku (/0 | keyword) :qty /1}

O14: filter ~(/state | eq "closed") | every ~((at :assignee | ne null))
